craft_notes: Sthāyin: spent-joy (nothing to get). Sanskrit first: eclipse + rhetorical kim + spent speaker → L4 sets eclipse line 1, zero line 2. Rows: row 3 (what/more frame). Rupture: semicolon after bliss — eclipse done, zero asked. Close: end-weight on this (the zero demonstrative). Minimal pass: semicolon for L3 comma. Read aloud: pales, gone, this? Rejected: 'surpassed' flat — kept? L4 'outshone' sings the eclipse; 'emaciated' for kṣīṇa — killed: gone plain, emaciation medical.

lines: The moon is outshone by tasting your own bliss;
sense gone within — what more is there than this?
l4.sanskrit_cite: svarūpānubhavāhlādadaśātītendusaṃsthitiḥ / avāptavyaṃ kim astīha kṣīṇāntaḥkaraṇasya me

reads_against.argmap: With moon eclipsed by own-form joy and inner sense wasted, nothing is left to get.
c1_essence: Moon eclipsed by own-form joy; inner sense gone: nothing to get.
